title: .tf-review.yml
description: Per-repo reviewer configuration, read from the PR's base commit so a PR can't weaken its own review.

tool_version.description: Version of the tool the workflow installs, which is OpenTofu unless the caller sets its tool input to terraform.

standards.description: The tf-standards source, fetched at this exact commit.

agents.description: The specialists to run. cost prices the plan with Infracost and judges the result, which needs the INFRACOST_CLI_AUTHENTICATION_TOKEN secret. security runs Checkov and judges the plan against the security standards. The orchestrator and the LLM arbiter join in M2 and always run.

references.description: Add to each finding's suggestion from imported reference material, from Azure Policy, the Cloud Adoption Framework and the azurerm docs, searched for that finding. It never changes a finding, and can't create one (D42, D50).

comment_min_severity.description: Findings below this severity stay out of the PR comment.

mode.description: blocking fails the check only on findings a policy or allowlisted scanner reported as high itself, never on a model's finding or through a merge; a review that couldn't run never fails it (D9, D55).
